verdict.rationale: Moneybird has a documented public REST API on developer.moneybird.com. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 and personal API tokens with selectable scopes, token refresh and revocation, and resource endpoints such as contacts for reading, creating and updating data. The API is positioned as the base for its MCP server and CLI, and an LLM-oriented llms.txt is served. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the following endpoints to get information about contacts, create new contacts or update existing contacts.
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
Alternatively, you can create a personal API token that simplifies the setup, at a cost of security.
For a personal API token, you can use the checkboxes to select the scopes you need.
